title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery — Committee on Waivers and Compromises Standards for Waiver Requests
content:
### Timeliness

A waiver request on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** is considered only if it is received not later than the debt type's waiver request window, in calendar days, after the date of the initial debt notice. Count calendar days starting the day after the notice date; a request received on the last day of the window is timely. The notice date and the date of receipt are taken from the system records of the debt and of the request.

| Request received (notice date is Day 0, window is W days) | Considered |
|---|---|
| Day W | Yes — the last day of the window is timely |
| Day W plus 1 | No |

### Completeness

A waiver request is complete only with a Financial Status Report, because the Committee on Waivers and Compromises weighs equity and good conscience against the debtor's finances. A request without one is recorded, but the debtor is asked to send it. Submitting the waiver request and the Financial Status Report is the debtor's own act.

### Bar

Waiver is never granted when the debt record carries a fraud, misrepresentation or bad faith finding.

### Effect on collection

A request received within the collection-hold window, in calendar days after the notice date, holds collection until it is decided; a later but timely request is decided while collection continues.

| Request received | Collection while it is decided |
|---|---|
| Within the collection-hold window | Held |
| After the hold window, still within the waiver window | Continues |

### Decision

The Committee may grant all, part or none of the amount. A partial grant credits the waived amount and collection resumes on the remainder; a grant of the entire balance closes the debt as waived. The amounts collected after a timely request — the offsets and direct payments posted on the debt from the date the request was received through the date of its decision — that fall within the waived amount are refunded. The Committee's target for deciding a complete request is the debt type's decision goal.

**Hypothetical case.** A timely request received after the collection-hold window on a debt with 2,000.00 USD outstanding, so that collection continues and 300.00 USD is collected between receipt and decision; the Committee waives 1,200.00 USD. The waived amount is credited, collection resumes on the remainder, and the 300.00 USD collected after the request falls within the waived amount and is refunded.
